description: Returns one song of the calling account's notebook in full: the summary fields AND `song`, the canonical pivot payload (sections, lines, chords with their offsets, lyrics, detectedKey, metadata). That payload is exactly what jj_create_song and jj_update_song accept, so reading then writing back is a copy, not a translation. An unknown id and an id belonging to another account both return the same not-found error.

songId.description: Stable notebook song id (an "artist-title" slug), as returned by jj_list_songs.

name: jj_get_song
title: Get one notebook song
